ValidationRule.description: To ensure that all new Channel Assets must have NEW Status. CRM-9225 - Updated the validation rule to bypass for QDP Portal GDS
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Agency_Channel', ISNEW(), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status ,'New')), NOT( GDS_Name__c = 'QDP Portal') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Asset Status should be 'New' during creation
